vanillatalents.class.miner.desc: Underground and mining: faster breaking, bonus ores and night vision.
vanillatalents.class.farmer.desc: Farming and ranching: area harvest, extra animal drops and an aura that speeds up crops.
vanillatalents.class.explorer.desc: Exploration and mobility: more speed, less fall damage and less hunger while sprinting.
vanillatalents.class.warrior.desc: Melee combat: more damage with swords and axes, knockback and resistance.
vanillatalents.class.archer.desc: Ranged combat: faster draw and reload, extra projectile damage and saved arrows.
vanillatalents.class.angler.desc: Fishing, sailing and the ocean: faster and better catches, quicker boats and the trident against drowned and guardians.
vanillatalents.class.tamer.desc: Fight and travel in company: stronger wolves, sturdier horses and companions (cats, golems) that make a difference.
vanillatalents.class.builder.desc: For those who spend the game building: longer reach, fast dismantling, safe work at height and less cheap material spent.
